reason: The slice ray-bounces-and-burns-the-hero is complete. js/zap.js dozap() calls weffects(), which takes an aimed ray wand through ubuzz(), dobuzz(), zap_over_floor(), zap_hit(), bounce_dir() and zhitu()'s ZT_FIRE arm as far as the destroy_items() call at zap.c:4434, which is the new fail-closed boundary. The witness session seed5002-wizard-coverage-pair now emits 103 of its 410 screens, up from 88, and stops on step 103's space at that call. Every entry below is done, later or cannot-occur.

boundary.startingEvent: seed5002-wizard-coverage-pair segment 0 step 88, the byte l answering In what direction? for a zap of a wished wand of fire. The port already emits screens 0-87, so getobj(), zappable() and getdir() run today and u.dx = 1, u.dy = 0, u.dz = 0 is set when UnsupportedZapError('weffects() for object type 430') fires at js/zap.js:267-269.
boundary.endingEvent: The --More-- the top line raises when the turn's third message arrives. Recorded screen 88 is 'The bolt of fire bounces!  The bolt of fire hits you!--More--', cursor [61,0,1], with the beam painted across map row 7 at columns 73-77. The slice stops at zhitu()'s `if (!rn2(3)) (void) destroy_items(&gy.youmonst, AD_FIRE, orig_dam);` at zap.c:4434-4435, which becomes the new fail-closed boundary.
boundary.validInputs: A hero-aimed zap of a wand whose objects[] row carries oc_dir RAY, in a game the port already reaches. seed5002 is playmode:debug with a ^W-wished wand of fire; the fresh differential picks its own seed and terrain. A vertical zap (u.dz nonzero) turned out to be inside rather than outside: dobuzz() forces the range to 1 for a bolt with no horizontal delta at zap.c:4824-4825, that one line is ported, and scripts/zap-ray.test.mjs drives every ray wand through it. What such a bolt cannot do is stop inside the boundary, because it hits the hero with no bounce message ahead of it and so raises no --More-- before destroy_items(); the deferral vertical-ray-reaches-destroy-items records that case and its recorded C answer. Monster-aimed rays and spell rays remain outside, refused by name at dobuzz()'s and weffects()' own entries.
boundary.observables: Every random-number call in source order, every screen and cursor from step 88 through step 102, and the transient beam glyphs. Step 88's whole log is five draws: rn2(19) from weffects()'s exercise(A_WIS, TRUE), rn2(7)=5 from dobuzz()'s rn1(7, 7) giving range 12, rn2(20)=2 from zap_hit(), d(6, 6)=25 from zhitu()'s ZT_FIRE arm, and rn2(5)=1 from burnarmor(). The status line reads HP:12(12) at steps 85, 88 and 103, so the hero loses no hit points anywhere inside this boundary.

sourceReview:
Attested by the worker who ported the slice. Every C span named in the entries above was read in nethack-c/upstream before the JavaScript was written: zap.c weffects() 3430-3476, ubuzz() 4758-4762, buzz() 4764-4768, dobuzz() 4779-5037, zhitu() 4400-4591, bounce_dir() 4663-4701, zap_hit() 4704-4720, zap_over_floor() 5140-5497, burn_floor_objects() 4596-4656, zaptype() 88-96, flash_types[] 71-85, flash_str() 6428-6445, adtyp_to_prop() 5653-5674, u_adtyp_resistance_obj() 5675-5698 and inventory_resistance_check() 5709-5718; trap.c burnarmor() 87-160, erode_obj() 170-353 and grease_protect() 358-385; display.c zapdir_to_glyph() 2460-2470, reset_glyphmap()'s zap arm 2877-2883, zapcolors[] 2661-2665 and tether_glyph() 1126-1133; pline.c set_msg_dir() 83-89, pline_dir() 113-123 and vpline()'s a11y prefix 155-190; invent.c carrying() 1493-1504; timeout.c burn_away_slime() 446-453; decl.c materialnm[] 88-95; and the hack.h, objclass.h, youprop.h and display.h macros each of those reads.

The evidence: seed5002-wizard-coverage-pair goes from 88 to 103 of 410 screens, its cursors from 89 to 104 and its animation frames from 0/8 to 8/8, and scripts/scan-sessions.mjs reports its stop as the destroy_items() refusal on step 103's space, which is the boundary this slice set. The first random-number divergence for that session is now index 5888, measured by replaying both segments and comparing the logs; indices 5883-5887 are exactly the five draws step 88 records, and the port made none of them before. scripts/run-ray-zap.mjs records five fresh segments with the patched C reference and replays them with the port: 5 segments, 20069 PRNG calls, 99 screens, 99 cursors and 33 animation frames, all matching. Every one of the 28 tests in scripts/zap-ray.test.mjs was watched failing on a targeted edit to the production line it covers before it was committed.

What this attestation does not cover: the terrain arms of zap_over_floor(), which the matrix's plain-floor segments cannot reach and which the deferral zap-over-floor-terrain-arms-refuse records; and the case one call past the boundary, which the deferral vertical-ray-reaches-destroy-items records with its recorded C answer.
